functionalReqs: Predict P(click) for thousands of candidate ads per request
Use user, ad, advertiser and context features
Update quickly for new ads and campaigns
Probabilities used in auction ranking (bid × pCTR)
hints: Why does calibration matter more here than in most ranking problems?
Features are huge sparse IDs (user, ad, query). How do models handle them? (Hashing, embeddings, feature crosses.)

Logistic regression with hashed crosses as baseline → deep models (Wide & Deep, DCN, DeepFM) with ID embeddings; training on impression logs with click labels (handle delayed clicks); negative down-sampling with calibration correction; online/incremental training; evaluate log loss and AUC, plus calibration plots; A/B test revenue and user metrics.
problemStatement:
Design the **click-through rate (CTR) prediction** model used in an ad auction: for each candidate ad, predict the probability that this user clicks it.

Predictions feed directly into auction prices, so they must be well calibrated.

scaleHints.storage: Hundreds of billions of impressions per month

title: Design Ad Click-Through Rate Prediction
